name: Open-Book Thoracic Rotation

instructions.description: Lie on one side with hips and knees bent and arms extended forward.
Sweep the top arm across the body while following it with the eyes.
Allow the upper trunk to rotate without forcing the knees apart.
Return slowly and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record range only when measured consistently; do not force end range.

variations.variationDescription: Open-Book Thoracic Rotation — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Keep the movement within a comfortable range.
